title: DOCUMENTATION & DEMO (re-audit)
exit_gate_note: The jury can deploy from the README and verify the key claims mechanically: make verify -> 12/12 PASS (427 tests, 21 artifacts), make docs-verify -> 23 measured facts / 11 checks PASS, make demo-backup -> all four probes green. Every published number is rendered from an artifact and diff-checked, with four independent failure mechanisms proven to fire.

supersedes.reason: Prior claim of DONE asserted 'complete, honest documentation' without (a) Task 15.3 deliverables existing at all, (b) any mechanical link from claims to artifacts, and with a factually wrong encoding-transform list plus a stale 317-test count.

tasks.15.1: DONE - README/DESIGN (rewritten as-built)/LIMITATIONS/DATA_DICTIONARY present and non-placeholder
tasks.15.2: DONE - THREAT_MODEL corrected (fake transform list removed), INDEPENDENCE verified
tasks.15.3: DONE - NEW docs/API_USAGE.md + docs/POLICY_PROTOCOL.md (envelopes, tool enum, 11 error codes, budgets, limits, worked session)
tasks.15.4: DONE - primary 3-minute demo (make demo, seed 2025) + NEW technical backup demo (make demo-backup, 4 probes), documented in docs/DEMO.md
tasks.15.5: DONE - generated facts block in README rendered from artifacts + prose assertions + evidence->claim map
tasks.15.6: DONE - tools/verify_doc_claims.py (4 mechanisms) + 18 tests; authoritative run relocated to judge/verify.py after artifact synthesis; stale-literal denylist; decision-ID referential integrity

defects_fixed: Task 15.3 had no deliverable: no API_USAGE.md, no policy protocol doc existed
Undocumented tool-name trap: core protocol accepts 'calc', official adapter accepts 'calculator', each rejects the other
docs/THREAT_MODEL.md claimed 9 encoding transforms but listed 8 names, 4 of them incorrect identifiers
README claimed 317 tests (measured 410 -> 427 after this phase's new tests)
README baseline table durations/steps did not match trajectories.jsonl
Phantom decision ID D-03-01 cited in DESIGN.md (now blocked by an automated referential-integrity check)
docs/DESIGN.md described shipped components as 'planned, Phase 9/Phase 6'
Doc-claims gate initially byte-compared sampled timings, so it failed on the next verify run (self-defeating); stable facts only
Doc-claims report initially written into the frozen 21-artifact evidence dir, making artifact counts order-dependent; relocated
One documented demo probe was not runnable (score_episode on checked-in episodes/dev/* has no sealed/truth.json, by design D-01-04)
Doc-claim tests placed inside RC-001 could not work: they read verify_summary.json, which the same run writes last (chicken-and-egg FileNotFoundError on a clean tree)
Circular self-reference: asserting the gate pass-ratio made a doc-drift failure persist a failing summary that poisoned every subsequent run (deadlock)
A doc-claim test hardcoded the value to corrupt, so it silently stopped testing anything once that fact was removed

Hardened offline container rejected the new report directory: --read-only rootfs with tmpfs only for reports/latest and trajectories caused FileNotFoundError. Fixed in Dockerfile (pre-create) + make docker-check (16 MB tmpfs) and made the checker report-write failure-tolerant

The container tmpfs over artifacts/trajectories masks the committed trajectories.jsonl, and make verify never regenerates it, so the documentation gate hard-failed in docker-offline. Baseline rows are now an optional fact block, probed and reported explicitly

The actual docker-only failure was the locale: python:3.11-slim runs with LC_ALL=C, so sys.stdout is ASCII and printing an em dash in test_doc_claims.setUpModule raised UnicodeEncodeError (core passed because its locale is UTF-8). Fixed with a single transliterating output path _say() and ASCII only in test prints; locked by TestLocaleSafety

limitations: README contains a generated block; hand edits fail the gate by design (use --write).
docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md field list is covered by placeholder/denylist scans but not individually re-derived from schemas.
The doc-claims gate proves docs match artifacts, not that artifacts measure the right thing (that is RC-001..RC-012).
Sampled performance numbers stay in performance_report.json and are deliberately not asserted in docs.
make demo-backup re-runs the full verify (~63s), so it is a reviewer tool rather than a per-commit gate.

L-H: claimed baseline numbers derive from artifacts/trajectories/trajectories.jsonl, which make verify does not regenerate (produced by make official-eval and committed); regenerating is a manual reviewer step.
next_phase: Phase 16 - release candidate: clean-clone verify on a fresh runner, offline Docker re-run, secrets/file-list/size audit, tag + GitHub release.
